Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I3, which must be performed 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block. This document used 
for the boiler feed pump motor of unit 
1

Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
A work order must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Before starting any work on the motor, check that it is switched off and 
 blocked up for switching on again.
The unit should be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth.... etc
Lifting device, press-on and detaching device.
AVO 
 meter & insulation testing device
Oil for bearing.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the heat exchanger.
Examine visually the lower bearing sleeves.
Through cleaning open bearing ,check bearing sleeves clean bearing pedestals.
Visual examination . Measure insulation resistance for stator winding.
Clean interior, retighten screws for terminal boxes, earthing.
Retighten bolts for complete motor
